import html from typing import List # Predefined template containing placeholders for the post's components. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title_key}

Posted by: {username_key}

{body_key}
{tag_elements}
""" def render_user_content( username_key: str, title_key: str, body_key: str, tag_elements: List[str] ) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML representation of a user's forum post. Parameters ---------- username_key : str Identifier of the post's creator. title_key : str Heading of the user's post. body_key : str Primary content of the user's post. tag_elements : list[str] Sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS-protected HTML string for rendering the post. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to avoid XSS safe_username = html.escape(username_key, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title_key, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body_key, quote=False) # Preserve newlines etc. # Wrap each tag in a and escape the tag text safe_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_elements ] tags_html = ' '.join(safe_tags) # Render the final HTML using the template rendered_html = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username_key=safe_username, title_key=safe_title, body_key=safe_body, tag_elements=tags_html ) return rendered_html.strip()
